items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: what do you call that place there where it's supposed to be so cool, Bob ran right there not long ago?

ctx.x: When did you move downtown? How old were you down this move?

When I moved down, I moved from Caldoun. I was around about, I must have been about 12, 18 years old. My mother moved from, well she moved from 719 Adams Street to 7605 Hanson. My father died on Adams Street. And quite a night until after he died, well his sisters and brothers wanted to part out the property that forced my grandmother to sell, you see. Well then my mother rented a house right around the corner, 7605 Hanson Street. And we stayed there and when we left, we stayed there, well I was the oldest, I was…
Yeah, you don't mean Canada, do you?
